listing.name: Ratchet & Clank (2016) — ratchet-clank-pc (btsouth)
listing.summary: Preview 0.1: every planet loads/plays at 60 FPS preset with cutscenes, sound, controller and saves. No start-to-finish completion. Shadow flicker, first-visit shader stutter and unstable higher frame rates remain. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own base 01.00 decrypted CUSA01073 directory with eboot.bin, sce_module and sce_sys; no update merged. Extract owned PKG using a recent extractor. Game files remain required at runtime.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README recommends Ratchet-Clank-port-x86_64.AppImage and adjacent sha256 file. Launcher selects game folder; first start prepares image and shader caches. Source alternative uses build.sh and optional GTK4 launcher. Saves/cache in ~/.local/share/ratchet-port; one running copy due to /tmp/.racS link.
